newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean offers down sharply.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean offers down sharply.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis values eased Friday in reaction to sagging CIF values and light export and processor demand, exporters said.
Soybeans for July were offered 73 cents per bushel over CBOT August, down 12 cents from Thursday.
Corn basis offers also eased in reaction to falling CBOT futures prices as well as light export demand.
Hard red winter and soft red winter wheat FOB basis values were mostly unchanged.
Tunisia bought 150,000 tonnes U.S. wheat, half hard red winter and half soft red winter, for August-October shipment.
The CCC late Friday reported the purchase of 44,731 tonnes of hard red winter wheat for donation to Ethiopia.
